title: The Late Summer
author: Jude Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Eriksen, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
